prompts.stances: Edit the provided rear-view Wyrm Aspirant seed into ONE production game sprite sheet: EXACTLY 9 frames in a strict 3 columns by 3 rows uniform square-slot grid, reading left to right then top to bottom. Transparent background. Same draconic humanoid warrior in every frame, same rear three-quarter camera facing upper right, same red-orange scales, layered bronze dark plate back armor, hooked spines, long thick red curling tail, tattered blue-black rear tabard, huge curved metallic blade in right hand, spiked left forearm. Preserve identity, realistic painterly game-sprite rendering and outfit proportions of seed exactly. Full body and weapon entirely inside each slot, ample transparent gap, equal scale, feet on same baseline, no labels borders shadows scenery. Nine DISTINCT readable poses: 1 neutral ready stance matching seed; 2 SMASH both knees deeply flexed and sword raised far overhead; 3 ATTACK strong forward sword chop with arm extended; 4 SWEEP sword sweeping horizontally right to left with torso rotation seen from rear; 5 COUNTER weight on back foot, blade cocked diagonally beside right shoulder; 6 DEFEND crouched with spiked left forearm raised shielding head and blade crossed inward; 7 EVADE deep lateral sidestep left with bent knees and tail counterbalance; 8 SPELL left arm extended upward casting small contained orange ember flame, right sword lowered; 9 PREPARING hunched forward charging stance sword held back low. Genuine distinct anatomical limb poses, no duplicates or rotations of the entire sprite. Keep all heads turned away with no front face. Asset sheet, no poster composition.

Preserve seed outfit proportions and detailed painterly game sprite style. Each equal square slot contains one complete character and entire sword with clear empty margins; shared character scale and foot floor baseline. No text, numbers, borders, scenery, ground, shadows, duplicates, global image rotation, or motion blur. TOP ROW is 4 successive real sword attack animation keyframes: anticipation winding blade back and up with torso coiled; decisive downward-forward strike in wide step with right arm fully extended; follow-through blade swept low across opposite side and shoulders turned away; recovery withdrawing arm and bringing feet back to ready. BOTTOM ROW is 4 successive real dodge animation keyframes: anticipation lowering center of gravity and bending knees; evasion sharply leaning and stepping laterally left with tail extended counterbalance; follow-through crouched side lean with sword kept close; recovery rising back to ready.
